subject: [PATCH 17/60] PM: hibernate: size the image from common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the hibernation mechanism in Linux by accurately sizing the image from common memory. The current implementation counts free pages of every populated zone as room for the hibernation image, but image pages can only come from common memory. This patch specifically addresses this issue by modifying functions like `count_free_highmem_pages` and `hibernate_preallocate_memory` to count free pages only in zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes.
